heroHeadline: Hormuz Captains Earning 'Mercenary' Wages as Ship Attacks and Freight Costs Paralyze Persian Gulf
heroSubtitle: Ship crews demand extraordinary risk premiums to transit the Strait of Hormuz; at least 11 vessels attacked since early October, tanker freight rates surpassing a SpaceX rocket launch and rerouting forcing Cape of Good Hope detours
